concerns.text: T021 implements the LMM formula but lacks explicit logic to attempt the FULL model (with covariates) before falling back. FR-004 and SC-002 require the system to fit the full model and only simplify upon convergence failure. The task description does not mandate the 'try full, fallback on fail' sequence, risking a silent relaxation where the simplified model is used by default.

T026 is marked as unchecked (pending) in the task list, yet the spec's 'Edge Cases' and FR-004 mandate a Shapiro-Wilk normality test with a fallback to Wilcoxon signed-rank for non-normal data. Leaving this task unimplemented violates the requirement to handle non-normal distributions as defined in the spec.

T023 (multiple-comparison correction) is unchecked. FR-005 and SC-003 explicitly require Bonferroni/Benjamini-Hochberg correction when >1 test is run. The absence of this task implementation means the project cannot satisfy the statistical validity requirement or control the Family-Wise Error Rate.

T024 (Cohen's d calculation) is unchecked. FR-006 mandates computing effect sizes with 95% CIs. Without this task, the analysis output will lack required effect size metrics, violating the spec's acceptance criteria for US2.

T025 and T025b (MDE calculation and logging) are unchecked. FR-007 and SC-005 require sensitivity analysis (MDE) for power=0.80 and reporting limitations if observed effects are smaller. The lack of implementation renders the sensitivity analysis requirement unmet.

T017b (saving transition-probability tables) is unchecked. Constitution Principle VI and Assumption 1 require storing 'transition-probability tables' and 'Markov model state' for reproducibility. Without this artifact, the experimental design documentation is incomplete, violating the Constitution.

T034 and T034a (runtime/memory tests) are unchecked. SC-004 requires verifying the 6-hour runtime and 7GB RAM limit using `cgroups` or `ulimit`. The absence of these tests means the computational feasibility success criterion is unverified and unenforceable.

T034b and T034c (reproducibility checklist and execution) are unchecked. SC-006 requires a reviewer to reproduce results within 6 hours. Without the checklist and validation task, this success criterion is not actionable or verifiable.
